applies_to.launch: codex exec --json (rollout file is the saved session; the exec stream is a separate live-output contract)
applies_to.selection: route native_session_file; experimental combined-source evidence only

executor: journal-ocsf-writer CodexRolloutMapper (direct Java); one record at a time; state: turn in force, custom_tool_calls seen, token_counts of the current turn, artifact time fallback
record_discriminator: type, then payload.type, then payload.item.type / payload.role

tool_kind_table.note: Name table only; the nested command text is never parsed for classification (owner decision 2026-10-14).

rules.settings: cwd -> working_directory; cli_version -> version; model_provider -> provider; git.branch -> git_branch
rules.residual: whole record in data (base_instructions, originator, history_mode, context_window, creator ids)

rules.owner: turn_uid = turn_id (also sets the turn in force for user/assistant messages)
rules.settings: cwd -> working_directory; model -> model; approval_policy -> approval_policy; sandbox_policy -> sandbox_policy (object)
rules.residual: whole record in data (permission_profile, file_system_sandbox_policy, effort, timezone, ...)

rules.owner: turn_uid = the turn_context.turn_id in force at this ordinal
rules.note: Codex writes the environment context as a user-role message before the prompt; both map here. The semantic contract's classifier distinguishes them.

rules.activity: 2 Completed (rule codex.rollout.activity.v1: a response_item message is written once, after the response)

rules.owner: response_uid = payload.item.id (same id as the response_item message: two occurrences, one response)

rules.fields: context_kind = response_item/message/developer; rendered_role = developer; content_blocks from payload.content

rules.status: 0 Unknown, status_basis 3 Not derivable: the call-level output reports no call-level status; per-command outcomes are operations

attribution.outcome: 1 Unique when exactly one candidate (tool_call_uid set, method 2 Derived by rule); 2 Ambiguous when more than one (tool_call_uid ABSENT, candidates listed); 3 Unattributed when none

rules.status: status_id 1 when item.status == completed, 2 when failed (Reported)
rules.residual: item in tool_operation.data; whole record in data

rules.usage: payload.usage -> scope 2 Model response status 2 Final (the cited response's own usage, reported once); payload.turn_token_usage -> scope 3 Prompt turn status 1 Provisional (cumulative so far); payload.thread_token_usage -> scope 5 Session status 1 Provisional (cumulative so far) (rule codex.rollout.token_usage_record.v1)

every event_msg token_count in the same turn before task_complete -> usage_observation scope 3 Prompt turn from info.total_token_usage; the last one is status 2 Final (rule codex.rollout.token_count.v1), earlier ones 1 Provisional; each cites its own record
rules.cost: none: the rollout reports no monetary cost
rules.status: 0 Unknown with basis 3: task_complete carries no status and no error field

rules.selector: token_count (retained whole; usage rides on the turn completion), other item types, other roles, unknown types
any line that is blank, not UTF-8, not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing, or cut off by the end of the source
rules.residual: raw_data (text) or raw_bytes_b64 (bytes); parse_status_id 5 Incomplete at source end when the source ended mid-record

rules.selector: a parsed record whose mapper threw
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis names the exception. A defect of the writer is visible, never a lost record

unavailable_at_source: call-level status of a multi-command exec
provider organization (model_provider is a reported string)
